title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context from the previous page: B is a k-linear tensor (⊗-)category and B' → B ranges over k-linear ⊗-functors. Taking B' = K, a k-linear category built from finite ½-simplicial (semi-simplicial) sets, a k-linear functor F: K → B 'is' a complex C ∈ B^·. A 'multiplicative structure' on C (to be called 's.h. mult. demi-simpliciale') is then a monoidal structure on F for the monoidal structure on K given by the join *.

This page makes that explicit.
(i) Giving lax-monoidal structure maps F(X) ⊗_B F(Y) → F(X*Y) amounts to giving them on the k-linear 'bicategory' A×A of pairs of generators (C^i, C^j) in K×K. These are generators corresponding to the standard simplices. In other words, one gives maps of bicomplexes F(C^i) ⊗_B F(C^j) → F(C^i * C^j) in B.
(ii) He then makes these explicit through the chain models of the simplices. The (augmented) chain complex of a full simplex is an exterior algebra ΛΦ_* on its vertex module, with Koszul-type differential. The join of two simplices corresponds to the tensor product: chains(Δ^i * Δ^j) = ΛΦ_* ⊗ ΛΦ_*, since Λ(V⊕W) = ΛV ⊗ ΛW.
(iii) So the structure maps become (1): C^i ⊗_B C^j → Hom_k^·((C^i_· * C^j_·)^∨, C^·), where C^i = F(C^i).
(iv) Equivalently, by adjunction, (2): (C^i ⊗_B C^j) ⊗_k C_{ij} → C^·, with C_{ij} = C_i * C_j the (dual) join chain complex in K^·.
(v) In the cochain version (1*), (2*), the parametrising complex is ΛΦ^* ⊗ ΛΦ^* and the target is C^* = DP^*(C), presumably the Dold–Puppe normalised (cosimplicial) cochain object. This yields maps u_{ij}: (C^i ⊗_B C^j) ⊗_k (ΛΦ^* ⊗ ΛΦ^*) → C^*.
(vi) The next page imposes compatibility of the u_{ij} with the ½-simplicial structure (fixed i,j) and with the differentials (varying i,j), plus unit, associativity and commutativity data.

In modern terms: a multiplicative structure on a cochain complex is a monoid for the Day convolution induced by the join on functors K → B. Equivalently, it is a family of products parametrised by the chain complexes of joins of simplices. This is a semi-simplicial, operad-free way to encode homotopy-coherent (E∞-type, 'strongly homotopy') cochain multiplications. Purpose: to define multiplicative structures on ∂-perfect ½-simplicial complexes so that the dévissage can respect them.
errors: The join on K has no unit unless the empty simplex (augmentation) is included. Grothendieck notices this himself on the next page ('K n'a pas d'unité pour * !'). As written here, unit compatibility cannot yet be expressed.
The join raises dimension by one (Δ^i * Δ^j = Δ^{i+j+1}). Identifying chains of the join with ΛΦ⊗ΛΦ needs augmented/reduced chains and a degree shift, which the page leaves implicit.
The compatibility conditions are left as '...' and only begin on the next page. The definition is incomplete on this page.

ideas.what: Multiplicative structure on a complex C ∈ B^· defined as a lax monoidal structure on the corresponding k-linear functor F: (K,*) → B, where K is a linearised semi-simplicial category with join
ideas.modern_name: Monoid for Day convolution / lax monoidal functor from a join-monoidal indexing category; homotopy-coherent (E∞-like) cochain algebra
ideas.usually_credited_to: Day (1970) for convolution; May, Hinich–Schechtman, Mandell, Berger–Fresse for E∞ cochain structures
ideas.where_published: Possibly echoed in Pursuing Stacks (1983) discussions of linear/abelian homotopy; not as such

ideas.what: Chains of a simplex as an exterior algebra ΛΦ, with join of simplices ↔ tensor product of exterior algebras
ideas.modern_name: Koszul complex model of simplex chains; join ↔ tensor of augmented chains

ideas.what: Products parametrised by chain complexes of joins, (C^i⊗C^j)⊗C_{ij} → C, compatible with faces: a multiplication 'up to coherent homotopy' indexed by simplices
ideas.modern_name: Algebra over a chain-level operad / cup-i–type structure (Steenrod cup-i, surjection or Barratt–Eccles operads)

missed.claim: Grothendieck sketches a definition of 'semi-simplicial strongly homotopy multiplicative' complexes in an arbitrary k-linear ⊗-category B. It is based on join-monoidal functors out of a linearised semi-simplicial category rather than on operads. The construction is not finished: unit compatibility fails because K has no join unit.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is an early (c.1975) operad-free route to E∞-type structures on cochains in general tensor categories, via Day convolution over the join. It is modestly interesting historically. Comparable machinery now exists (operads, ∞-categorical monoidal functors), so the novelty is mainly as a pre-history item.

deep.surprise_reason: This is an unpublished, early, idiosyncratic encoding of homotopy-coherent multiplicative structures via join-monoidal functors and exterior-algebra models of simplices. The underlying ideas (Day convolution, E∞ cochains, Koszul models) are now standard, and the page is fragmentary.
transcription_corrections: Under the ⊗ symbols the subscripts are B (⊗_B) and k (⊗_k), as in (2), (1*), (2*).
'ΛΦ' is likely an exterior algebra (chains of a simplex). 'DP^*(C)' plausibly refers to Dold–Puppe.
The first line is largely illegible; 'Comme dualité' is doubtful (possibly 'Comme d'habitude').
In (2) the annotation over C_i*C_j reads like 'dual = C^{·∨}_{ij}'; the under-brace marks it as '∈ K^·'.
